text: Agent traces include messages, tool calls, observations, and final answers.
Context precision measures whether retrieved passages are useful for the answer.
Context recall measures whether expected evidence appears in retrieved context.
Faithfulness checks whether an answer is grounded in retrieved evidence.
Prompt robustness is measured by stable behavior across prompt variants.
Kendo practice emphasizes focused attention and disciplined repetition.
Benchmark cards should include metrics, reproduction commands, and limitations.
Tool policies should deny high-impact tools unless explicit approval exists.
